title: My Dinosaur Just Ruined My Job Interview
production_status: review cut; viewer votes not yet counted
description: Max has one chance to pay rent. His dinosaur has other plans. Vote A or B! #AIHOUSE #AnimatedComedy #Shorts

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: MAX! WHY IS YOUR RESUME ON FIRE?!

scenes.speaker: Max
scenes.line: It's fine! The dinosaur just gave it a glowing review.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Correction. Your qualifications are now medium rare.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: The interview is on video. Hide the dinosaur!

scenes.speaker: Max
scenes.line: Too late. He joined the meeting as my manager.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Great. Your boss has eaten the hiring manager.

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Quick! Do we blame the Wi-Fi, or let him interview?
